allometry.note: Rough heights from general knowledge: one and a half to two metres within 15 to 30 years. Wide tolerances.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye from photographs: green tuberculate joints, yellowish sheathed spines that grey with age, a dark trunk; green, smooth hanging fruit. Its flower laid out whorl by whorl (spec rework P5b): its tepals on a spiral (their count by hand: no flora counts them) on a floral cup above the inferior ovary, from the characters of Cactaceae by the rules at the flowering plants. Its 200 stamens by hand, the most a flower draws, for the numerous ones every flora gives.

appearance.bodies.stem.spines.glochid.note: Britton and Rose's The Cactaceae (vol. 1, 1919, pp. 42 and 57 to 67): the areoles bear glochids above the spines, here small, whitish to light yellow. Their count, length and angle are set by eye like a prickly pear's, smaller, as no flora measures them.

appearance.bodies.stem.spines.radial.cou.note: Spec rework E6c: the cacti's ribs, areoles and spines grown from the characters their floras state, in each body look that has ribs or a spine set of that role.

appearance.bodies.stem.spines.radial.len.note: Spec rework E6c: the cacti's ribs, areoles and spines grown from the characters their floras state, in each body look that has ribs or a spine set of that role.

appearance.organs.flower.shape.corolla.note: How PlantGen draws a flower, a choice of the model's (spec rework P5): the flower characters set a flower card's perianth, its parts, how they differ by place, how far the corolla is joined into a tube, a floral cup, where the ovary sits, a resupinate flower's turn, its stamens, staminodes and carpels and its spurs. The rules also set these fields in a season's flower and bud looks that draw a flower, unless set there by hand.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a small tree 1.5 to 4 m tall with a short trunk and drooping branches of joints 5 to 20 cm long that break off at a touch. Pink flowers at the joint tips grow green fruit, and fruit flowers again on old fruit, so chains of up to a dozen or more fruit hang from the branches. Not fitted to measurements.

generator.params.dioecious.note: How PlantGen draws the sexes, a choice of the model's (dioecy, 2026-10-14): a plant bears both sexes, unless its taxa state it dioecious.

generator.params.joint_length.note: Spec rework E6c: the joints of chollas and prickly pears from their stated form and size.

generator.params.joint_radius.note: Spec rework E6c: the joints of chollas and prickly pears from their stated form and size.

generator.params.joints.note: Spec rework E6c: the joints of chollas and prickly pears from their stated form and size.

generator.params.sex.note: How PlantGen draws the sexes, a choice of the model's (dioecy, 2026-10-14): a plant's sex is its own draw, dealt across a package's seeds so that both sexes grow; the typical plant (sex 0.5) is female, so it shows its fruit.

generator.program.note: The cacti's own program (growth plan G2.3a): columns, barrels and chains of joints, their ribs, areoles and spines from each species' look.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy (milestone F1). Calibration against measurements and photographs comes later.
